roleCode.description:
Assigned user role.

Roles are tiered, and the higher role has all the permissions of the lower role.
Order of roles, from highest to lowest: Owner > Admin > Basic user > Read only > No access.

- Owner: Full control over company settings, billing, personnel, and all technical resources. Always has CanCreateProjects, CanViewFinances, and CanEditFinances enabled (cannot be disabled).
- Admin: Full control over projects and technical resources, but cannot manage billing or Owner/Admin personnel. Always has CanCreateProjects enabled (cannot be disabled).
- Basic user: Can perform standard operations on projects.
- Read only: Can view project configurations and logs but cannot modify anything.
- No access: Cannot access any resources by default.

Project-specific roles override client-level roles. Users with CanCreateProjects enabled can create new projects and automatically receive the Owner role for those projects.

sudoUntil.description:
Sudo mode is a temporary mode, required for certain sensitive operations.
Sudo mode is used even if user doesn't have 2FA enabled, in that case, password is used to authenticate.
If the value is set, the user is in sudo mode until the time set.
If the time is in the past, the user is out of sudo mode and must re-authenticate with any method to re-enable it.

twoFAMethods.description:
If the value is set, user has 2FA enabled. Valid values are:
TOTP - a time-based one-time password second factor
U2F - a standard key-based second factor

Note:
FIDO2 (Passkey) is not a second factor, it fully replaces passwords and need for 2FA.
"twoFAVerified" will be automatically set to true if the user logged in using a Passkey.

twoFAVerified.description: If the value is false, user has 2FA enabled, and the login wasn't verified yet.

envIsolation.description: Defines which services may read the environment variables of a service. Values can be combined using spaces (e.g., service service@zcp). Allowed values: none (every service in the project sees them), service (only the service itself, the default), service@name (additionally the service named "name"), -service@name (the service named "name" is excluded even when none is set). Explicit variable referencing is still possible regardless of the isolation setting. Services inherit this value unless they set their own.

sshIsolation.description: Defines who is authorized to access the service via SSH. Values can be combined using spaces (e.g., project vpn). To exclude a specific access type, use a negative prefix (e.g., -vpn). Allowed values: project (anyone from the project), vpn (anyone from the VPN), service (anyone from the same service), service@name (anyone from the service named "name").

sshIsolation.description: Defines who is authorized to access the service via SSH. Values can be combined using spaces (e.g., project vpn). To exclude a specific access type, use a negative prefix (e.g., -vpn). roleCode.description:

Order of roles, from highest to lowest: Owner > Admin > Basic user > Read only > No access.
